phases.name: RECEIVER_SIDE_EXACT_RECEIPT
phases.goal: Bind every stable Quant PC arrival to a durable exact receiver receipt without inferring execution.
rules: Hash only after bounded size/mtime stability check.
Same semantic event plus same digest is idempotent.
Same event/dedupe identity plus different digest yields HOLD_RECONCILE.
Partial/truncated input is retained as evidence and fails closed.
RECEIVED, PARSED, LOADED and EXECUTED remain distinct evidence states.

phases.name: HRAIN_8008_SERVICE_AND_ROUTE_REPAIR
phases.goal: Make the intended HRAIN endpoint explicit and reachable from the correct network namespace.
diagnostics: Probe listener existence independently of application handler health.
From janus_titan_core, test whether 127.0.0.1 refers to the intended peer or only the Titan container namespace.
If peer is another Docker service, test Docker service/DNS identity instead of assuming loopback.
If peer is 192.168.1.92:8008, separate route, TCP-connect and handler-response tests.
Classify connect timeout versus read timeout versus application stall.
phases.isolation_rule: HRAIN outage must not block, erase or downgrade Quant PC receiver receipts.

phases.name: SQLITE_BUSY_AND_JSONL_DURABILITY
phases.goal: Turn observed JSONL fallback into a replayable no-loss/no-double-apply contract.
tasks: Identify concurrent SQLite writers and transaction duration.
Adopt bounded single-writer queue or documented WAL plus busy-timeout policy.
Assign stable idempotency key to every persistence event.
Replay fallback into SQLite through idempotent reconciliation only.
Prove process death between JSONL append and primary replay does not lose or double-apply a record.

phases.name: HANDOFF_LEDGER_BINDING
phases.goal: Project exact receiver receipts into FACE_HANDOFF_LEDGER without authority escalation.
phases.mapping: Quant arrival receipt -> handoff envelope -> ledger append -> downstream bounded consumer
phases.conflict_rule: Valid conflicting envelopes are retained and force HOLD_RECONCILE; no majority override.

phases.name: FAILURE_INJECTION_ACCEPTANCE
tests: duplicate arrival same event same digest
conflicting arrival same event different digest
receiver restart after hash before receipt commit
receiver restart after receipt commit before downstream consume
JSONL fallback then process death then replay
stale or duplicate downstream consume attempt

integration_with_162.contribution: Receiver integrity, durable receipt, outage recovery, fallback replay and exactly-once downstream consumption evidence.
